reports.title: Alignment Healthcare Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results, Updates Full-Year Outlook

guidance.heading: Outlook for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026
section: Full-year health plan membership and revenue guidance was raised to reflect continued sales momentum, while adjusted gross profit and adjusted EBITDA guidance was lowered to reflect higher medical costs experienced during the third quarter.

Three Months EndingDecember 31, 2026 | Twelve Months EndingDecember 31, 2026
$ Millions | No Less Than | No Less Than
Health Plan Membership | 305,000 | 305,000
Revenue | $1,316 | $5,245
Adjusted Gross Profit(1) | $104 | $575
Adjusted EBITDA(1) | $(28) | $100
(1) | Adjusted gross profit and adjusted EBITDA are non-GAAP financial measures presented as supplemental disclosure. We cannot provide estimated ranges for the most directly comparable GAAP measures without unreasonable efforts because of the uncertainty around certain items that may impact such GAAP measures, including equity-based compensation expense and depreciation and amortization, that are not within our control or cannot be reasonably predicted. See “Third Quarter 2026 Non-GAAP Reconciliation Tables” for additional information.
